name: v1
summary: Reference BlokDust v1 at a pinned commit: fetch/serve it, capture deterministic screenshots (with stage metrics) and audio (v1 on an OfflineAudioContext), extract draft block manifests + palettes from the running app, and verify manifests re-render v1's pixels.
usage: pnpm bd v1 capture tests/visual/fixtures/v1/*.json --blocks [--dpr 2] [--themes all] [--only name,...]
outputs: .cache/v1; tests/visual/reference/v1/*.png + manifest.json; tests/audio/reference/v1/*.wav + manifest.json; blocks/**/*.block.json drafts + blocks/v1-palettes.json; tests/visual/output/v1-verify/ (summary.json, v2/diff PNGs for failures)
